```{=html}
<div id="map-jul29" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-jul29').setView([37.5740, 126.9770], 13);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul+Station' },
    { name:'Studio KJD Hanbok 👘 (Booked)', lat:37.5785, lng:126.9735, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Studio+KJD+Hanbok+Seoul' },
    { name:'Gyeongbokgung Palace 🏯', lat:37.5796, lng:126.9770, c:'#8B0000', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gyeongbokgung+Palace' },
    { name:'Bukchon Hanok Village 🏘️', lat:37.5823, lng:126.9853, c:'#E53935', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bukchon+Hanok+Village+Seoul' },
    { name:'Jalpajin Buckwheat (Seochon) 🍜', lat:37.5788, lng:126.9689, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jalpajin+Buckwheat+Seochon+Seoul' },
    { name:'Jayeondo Salt Bread 🍞', lat:37.5810, lng:126.9700, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jayeondo+Sogeumppang+Seoul' },
    { name:'Dotori Garden Anguk 🍮 (Persimmon Dessert)', lat:37.5800, lng:126.9823, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dotori+Garden+Anguk+Seoul' },
    { name:'Cheonggyecheon Stream 🌊', lat:37.5694, lng:126.9830, c:'#1976D2', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Cheonggyecheon+Stream+Seoul' },
    { name:'Seoul Forest 🌳', lat:37.5446, lng:127.0378, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seoul+Forest' },
    { name:'Sancheong Charcoal Garden (Euljiro) 🔥', lat:37.5659, lng:126.9918, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Sancheong+Charcoal+Garden+Euljiro+Seoul' },
    { name:'Han River 🌙', lat:37.5285, lng:126.9299, c:'#5C6BC0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Han+River+Seoul' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```
